verdict.rationale: The Core API exposes most major UI-parallel actions—domain search/registration, DNS record management, transfers, WHOIS privacy, email forwarding, TLD pricing, and webhooks—covering the bulk of what a user does in the name.com dashboard. However, there is no explicit documentation claiming full UI/API parity, no OpenAPI spec was found (probe shows 404s for common spec paths), and some UI-only areas (e.g., billing/account management, bulk UI tools like 'expiring domains' browsing) aren't confirmed as API-accessible. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement or exhaustive endpoint list confirming all UI actions are API-reachable, and a public OpenAPI/swagger spec for verification.
